data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (search, open restaurant, set guests and date, click Notify, choose times and Confirm) and the parameters mostly line up; it adds optional city and slot-picking branches, and its "if no slot is available" condition and start/end time handling are slightly vague, but a browser automation could still be built from it.
